column2: The uplink received interference power, including thermal noise, within one physical resource block's bandwidth of resource elements as defined in TS 36.211 [3]. The reported value shall contain a set of Received Interference Powers of physical resource blocks  as defined in TS 36.211 [3]. The reference point for the measurement shall be the RX antenna connector. In case of receiver diversity, the reported value shall be linear average of the power in the diversity branches.For NTN, the reference point for the received interference power measurement shall be-the TAB connectors for SAN type 1-H defined in clause 4.3 in TS 36.108 [20],-the RIB for SAN type 1-O defined in clause 4.3 in TS 36.108 [20].
